_note: Shortcut table from docs/script-writer-integration.md, keyed by the wiki's own game id. 'catalogGame' is the canonical value from GET /api/search/options -- the ONLY strings the finder resolves. Sending anything else gets the game filter silently DROPPED and returns whole-catalog results (96% WAR OF SPARTA), so games with inCatalog:false must not be sent as a filter at all. Membership is re-checked against /api/search/options at runtime; this file is the mapping, not the authority.

LandOfHeros._note: Registered and filterable, but 0 indexed assets -- beats correctly return nothing.

ClashOfEmpire._note: The wiki calls this 'Clash Of Empire'; the doc's alias table calls it 'Castle of Empire'. Neither is in the catalog.
